keyMappings:
# Copy Current URL as Markdown ([Title](URL))
map ym copyCurrentUrl type=["title","url"] format="[${title}](${url})"
map <c-s-m> copyCurrentUrl type=["title","url"] format="[${title}](${url})"

# Copy Plain URL (yy and Ctrl+Shift+C)
map <c-s-c> copyCurrentUrl
map <c-C> copyCurrentUrl
map yy copyCurrentUrl

# Navigation (Vim Keys)
map j scrollDown
map k scrollUp
map d scrollPageDown
map u scrollPageUp
map gg scrollToTop
map G scrollToBottom

# Tabs on Right Side
map J previousTab
map K nextTab
map gT previousTab
map gt nextTab
map x removeTab
map X restoreTab
map t createTab
map r reload
map R reload hard

# Link Hints
map f LinkHints.activate
map F LinkHints.activateOpenInNewTab
map yf LinkHints.activateCopyLinkUrl
